description: The plot illustrates model performance as a function of sampling temperature, showing three accuracy curves for different methods. The x-axis is labeled “Temperature” on a linear scale, spanning approximately 0.1 to 0.9 with ticks at 0.1 intervals. The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy (Pass@1)” on a linear scale, ranging from about 62.5 to 82.5 with ticks every 2.5. The On-policy RL series is drawn in orange with upward-pointing triangle markers connected by a solid line; it starts near 64 at temperature 0.1, rises to around 71 at 0.2–0.3, increases to roughly 74–75 by 0.5–0.6, dips to about 71 at 0.7, then climbs to about 79 at 0.9. The LUFFY series is drawn in red with star markers and a solid line; it begins around 76–77 at 0.1, reaches about 80 at 0.2, stays around 77–80 through 0.6, then increases to roughly 82 at 0.7, is near 81 at 0.8, and ends around 83 at 0.9. The SFT series is drawn in teal with downward-pointing triangle markers and a solid line; it starts around 76–77 at 0.1, remains near 76 through about 0.4, drops to roughly 72–73 at 0.5, rises to about 79 at 0.6, dips to around 75 at 0.7, and then increases to roughly 78–80 by 0.8–0.9.
